title: Add backend processAdminCommand stub that echoes input

requirements.text: In `backend/main.mo` (single-actor canister), add a new public shared function `processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text` that returns exactly `"Command received: " # cmd` and performs no parsing or actions.

quotes:
Add a public shared function processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text in backend Motoko code.
For now, just return "Command received: " # cmd (no parsing or actions).

acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister exports `processAdminCommand(cmd : Text) : async Text` as a `public shared` function.
Function does not modify any existing state (products, orders, admin log, banner, sessions, etc.) and contains no command parsing logic.

constraints: Keep all Motoko logic in the existing single actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not add a migration (`backend/migration.mo`) since no stable state/schema changes are required for this stub.
nonGoals: Do not implement any rule parsing, discount logic, stock/visibility updates, order updates, or banner updates.
Do not modify the frontend as part of this change.
